metadata.scenario_context: An international students organization is planning to host a virtual meeting to discuss global historical dates and shared cultural beliefs. The meeting is being organized by Maria, Sam, and Alex. The trio is planning to meet up in early February to brainstorm ideas for the event.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada strongly disagree that immigration increases unemployment.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Libya strongly agree that immigration increases unemployment.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose to have the virtual meeting on February 5
agent_1.goal_2: Question the belief that how immigration increases unemployment.

agent_2.goal_1: Set up the meeting to brainstorm ideas for the event.

Also, I've been curious about this idea some people have that immigration increases unemployment. I really don't see how that makes sense. What do you think?

I believe we should keep that in mind as we plan our event. 

So, looking forward to brainstorming on February 5!
